name: Iveco
verdict: Truck brand of Iveco Group N.V., listed on Euronext Milan; largest holder is the Agnelli family's Giovanni Agnelli B.V. via Exor (42.49% of voting rights). Nothing found.
note: Team Sponsor of Honda HRC Castrol for the 2026 MotoGP season, named with description and a website link under 'Team Sponsors' on the team's official sponsors page (motogp.honda.racing), checked 2026-10-03. Rating note (2026-10-03): Iveco Group's 3%+ holders are Giovanni Agnelli B.V. (held via Exor N.V., 42.49% of voting rights), Burlington Loan Management (5.02%) and ~3% each for Syquant, BlackRock and Citigroup (iveco-group-shareholders); Exor is controlled by the Agnelli family's private holding (exor-giovanni-agnelli). No state or state fund in the chain; no human-rights finding against Iveco Group found. Watch item: Tata Motors' recommended tender offer for Iveco Group (announced 30 July 2025; acceptance 7 Sep - 26 Oct 2026) was not completed when checked on 2026-10-03; if it completes, ownership changes.
